items.title: Approved homepage identity and introduction
items.source: docs/content/v1-design-content.md and approved mainUI reference
missingFields: Final user confirmation for public biography use
items.requestedAction: Confirm or revise the approved homepage wording before content freeze.
items.fallback: Keep the current reference-approved concise wording.
items.launchImpact: The homepage can render, but the copy is not yet a verified public biography.

items.title: Public profile facts and biographies
items.source: User confirmation required
items.requestedAction: Provide and approve the public profile fact set.
items.fallback: Publish only the approved homepage identity line.
items.launchImpact: Story and profile sections remain intentionally incomplete.

items.title: Experience, education, skills, and résumé
items.source: User-supplied CV or primary records required
items.requestedAction: Supply the current CV and approve which fields may be public.
items.fallback: Omit the timeline and résumé download.
items.launchImpact: The Story route can launch without a CV but cannot make career claims.

items.title: Launch flagship project selection and order
items.source: Candidate list in maintaskplan.md
items.requestedAction: Approve the launch project set after source packs are reviewed.
items.fallback: Keep named Observatory concepts on hold and show no fabricated case studies.
items.launchImpact: Work cannot be considered launch-complete without verified projects.

items.title: StrudelAI case-study source pack
items.source: Repository and live-demo sources required
items.requestedAction: Provide or approve the canonical repository, demo, and media sources.
items.fallback: Omit the case study until its evidence pack passes review.
items.launchImpact: One expected flagship remains unavailable.

items.title: avatar-studio case-study source pack
items.source: Repository and approved public artifacts required
items.requestedAction: Identify the canonical source and the artifacts permitted for public display.
items.fallback: Publish no artwork, blend files, GLBs, or workspace previews.
items.launchImpact: The case study remains private until its public boundary is explicit.

items.title: iFoundYou case-study source pack
items.source: Repository and product notes required
items.requestedAction: Provide current product evidence and approve the privacy-safe framing.
items.fallback: Omit location and community claims and keep future intent unpublished.
items.launchImpact: The concept cannot appear as a shipped product.

items.title: OpenNemoClaw case-study source pack
items.source: Repository and package documentation required
items.requestedAction: Approve the canonical technical sources and contribution statement.
items.fallback: Keep the project out of launch navigation.
items.launchImpact: The technical portfolio has one fewer verified system.

items.title: WebDesigner case-study source pack
items.source: Repository, plugin metadata, and validation evidence required
items.requestedAction: Confirm the public repository boundary and Carlos's documented contribution.
items.fallback: Describe no internal architecture until sources are approved.
items.launchImpact: The creative-tools case study stays unpublished.

items.title: ASTRAEA, PINÁCULO, and Future Energy concepts
items.source: Approved homepage reference and design copy
items.requestedAction: Decide whether each name represents a real project, experiment, or visual concept.
items.fallback: Show the names only as clearly labeled Observatory concepts.
items.launchImpact: They may support the composition but cannot imply shipped work.

items.title: Repository and demo link register
items.source: Canonical project sources required
items.requestedAction: Supply the canonical link list for verification.
items.fallback: Render no unverified repository or demo links.
items.launchImpact: Case-study actions remain unavailable.

items.title: Reusable project screenshots and video
items.source: Original project media required
items.requestedAction: Provide original media and confirm reuse rights.
items.fallback: Use typographic case-study layouts without media.
items.launchImpact: Projects remain readable but visually sparse.

items.title: Portrait and personal brand assets
items.source: User-supplied originals required
items.requestedAction: Provide an approved portrait and any personal mark assets.
items.fallback: Use the existing typographic CC mark and no portrait.
items.launchImpact: Identity remains typographic rather than photographic.

items.title: Music and audio launch set
items.source: Audio files or approved embeds required
items.requestedAction: Choose a small launch set and approve every credit and right.
items.fallback: Keep the Sound route as an honest mute-first introduction without playback.
items.launchImpact: Sound Lab launches without playable media.

items.title: Video launch set
items.source: Video files or approved hosts required
items.requestedAction: Select videos and provide accessible playback material.
items.fallback: Omit video embeds at launch.
items.launchImpact: No blocked primary journey.

items.title: Curated trips and hobbies stories
items.source: User-selected stories and original media required
items.requestedAction: Select a small privacy-safe set and confirm media rights.
items.fallback: Omit personal travel and hobby stories from launch.
items.launchImpact: The portfolio remains professionally complete but less personal.

items.title: Contact method and social links
items.source: User confirmation required
items.requestedAction: Approve the public contact path and canonical social accounts.
items.fallback: Keep the Contact route informational without publishing private details.
items.launchImpact: Visitors cannot make verified contact from the site.

items.title: Site-wide voice and copy guide
items.source: Approved design copy and content-integrity rules
items.requestedAction: Review the draft voice conventions during the content pass.
items.fallback: Use concise English copy and explicit evidence-status labels.
items.launchImpact: Copy remains safe but may need a final voice edit.

items.title: Launch asset licensing and attribution register
items.source: Per-asset source and permission records
items.requestedAction: Review every selected asset before content freeze.
items.fallback: Exclude every asset with ambiguous rights.
items.launchImpact: Release is blocked if ambiguous third-party material remains.

items.title: Approved Natural Observatory homepage reference
items.source: docs/design/reference/mainUI-approved.png and provenance record
missingFields: Final decision on whether the image itself may ship publicly
items.requestedAction: Use it as the design source and confirm public poster permission separately.
items.fallback: Replace it with a rights-cleared authored scene poster before production.
items.launchImpact: The implementation direction is stable; the production poster may change.

items.title: Provider-neutral 3D reference packs
items.source: Approved scene specification and rights-cleared reference inputs
items.requestedAction: Create packs only from rights-cleared inputs after the provider gate.
items.fallback: Keep the poster-first semantic experience and use original procedural geometry later.
items.launchImpact: Full 3D is deferred without blocking core routes.

items.title: 3D provenance, license, and likeness register
items.source: Candidate asset production records
items.requestedAction: Complete a provenance record for every candidate before acceptance.
items.fallback: Reject undocumented assets and retain the static experience.
items.launchImpact: No candidate 3D asset can ship without this register.

items.title: Sound Lab interaction inputs
items.source: Approved audio files and analysis data required
items.requestedAction: Provide the approved audio set and truthful analysis metadata.
items.fallback: Render non-audio mechanical states only.
items.launchImpact: Sound-reactive motion remains disabled.

items.title: CC AI public knowledge ledger
items.source: Verified portfolio, CV, GitHub, and user-approved biography sources
items.requestedAction: Build the ledger only after public content sources are approved.
items.fallback: Keep CC AI visibly unavailable and preserve all non-chat routes.
items.launchImpact: Chat remains a disabled progressive enhancement.

items.title: CC AI evaluation and refusal set
items.source: Approved CC AI scope and future knowledge ledger
items.requestedAction: Create and pass the evaluation set before enabling public chat.
items.fallback: Do not expose a live model endpoint.
items.launchImpact: CC AI cannot launch without passing evaluation.

items.title: V1 content and asset freeze
items.source: Completed inventory, rights review, and approved launch records
items.requestedAction: Approve the final launch set after all critical gaps are resolved or explicitly deferred.
items.fallback: Ship no production release; continue with the verified preview foundation.
items.launchImpact: Production release remains blocked until the freeze is approved.
